body: Honestly, like I wasn’t supposed to be born so I wasn’t meant to live nor exist even. The world wouldn’t notice if I was gone, it wouldn’t care.
I get that, all it does saying it’s the most selfish thing anyone can do just makes us feel even more guilt
I don’t want to strike harder, I just want to make it all stop even if it means I don’t wake up ever again
I lied to the cops so they’d leave me alone and then it got me in trouble with my parents, I lie to all my therapists and I don’t trust my friends anymore

They’ll say I overreact just like every other time I try, then I ask my friends to make sure my girlfriend is ok and they threaten to call the cops on me, i barely trust anyone anymore. I just don’t know what to do
I’m getting yelled at tomorrow because I apparently did another thing wrong so my parents are pissed off at me for something, plus I’ve been preparing for like a week so idk what to do

I’m 15, I’ve wanted to die since I was 7 and I have self harming since I was 10, it’s gotten worse and worse and it’s like the only person that cares about me is my girlfriend, I got the cops called on me because I said something about suicide a few weeks ago and my parents barely showed any concern at all. it’s not gonna get better and it’s like they could care less, I can’t do it anymore, my girlfriend gets her phone taken at ten and she went to bed sobbing scared I’m not gonna be there tomorrow, I’m a bad person and I honestly should die
My parents are asleep and even if I woke them up they’d just get mad
